resale_co.name: Certificate for Home Sale
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Manville Division of Code Enforcement (housing inspector), on a combined application with the Bureau of Fire Safety smoke/CO certificate
requirements: Owner or agent applies on the Borough's combined Application for Smoke Alarm/Carbon Monoxide Alarm/Portable Fire Extinguisher Compliance and Certificate for Home Sale
Inspection appointment made by phone with the office
Housing inspector signs off on the home sale certificate; Fire Marshal signs off on the smoke/CO part
Application asks for buyer, owner's attorney, closing date, year built and whether the home is owner occupied, rental or bank owned
resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the combined application (pick up at the Construction Department window in Borough Hall or download it), pay by check payable to Borough of Manville, and make the inspection appointment by calling (908) 725-9478 Ext. 117. Division of Code Enforcement, 325 North Main Street, Manville, NJ 08835.

evidence.quote: APPLICATION FOR SMOKE ALARM/CARBON MONOXIDE ALARM/ PORTABLE FIRE EXTINGUISHER COMPLIANCE AND CERTIFICATE FOR HOME SALE
(The Owner / Agent must make an appointment for this inspection by calling (908) 725-9478 Ext. 117)

resale_co.notes: The application PDF is a scanned image, so its quotes were read by eye and may not be machine-checkable. The form shows a separate $50.00 Certificate for Home Sale with a Housing Inspector sign-off, but no ordinance or web page explaining what the home sale inspection covers or how long it is valid was found online, so confidence is medium. Manville also has a rental housing registration and inspection ordinance (2020-1232, amended 2021-1271) for rentals only. The zoning fee ordinance 2023-1308 mentions a 'continuing occupancy application' only under commercial permits.

requirements: 10-year sealed single-station smoke alarms (Borough says no other battery alarms accepted); hardwired interconnected alarms must all sound when one is tested and cannot be swapped for battery units
Smoke alarm on every level including the basement (at the base of basement steps), near steps to the second floor, at the top of fixed attic stairs, and within 10 feet of bedrooms
Carbon monoxide alarm near sleeping rooms in homes with a fuel-burning appliance, fireplace or attached garage (all-electric homes with none of these are exempt)

Portable 2A-10B:C fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress, mounted with bracket, serviced/tagged within 12 months or with a recent receipt, manual left for the buyer (Borough Ordinance still requires it)
Home security alarm systems are not tested

authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on business days before the change of occupant: more than 10 business days for the lowest fee. Certificate is good for six months. Cancellations need 48 hours notice.

fire_cert.notes: Fees come from Fire Safety Ordinance 2023-1306 (Section 14) and match the 2025 fee letter in the application packet ($45.00 / $90.00 / $161.00, reinspection $35.00). The Borough keeps the fire extinguisher as a local requirement by ordinance (Section 15) even though P.L.2025, c.19 dropped it from the state sale certificate; the 2025 packet says so in writing. Ordinance quotes are split across PDF lines, so short line fragments are quoted.
